title: Funding Methods and ACH Release Schedule for Personal Sender Account Levels
content:
The verification level of a Personal Sender Account decides which funding methods its personal transfers may use and how ACH-funded principal is released to the payout partner.

## Funding methods permitted

| Level | Debit card | Credit card | ACH bank debit | Instant pay-by-bank (RTP or FedNow) | Inbound domestic wire |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | yes | no | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Verified | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Paloma Verified Plus | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Paloma Enhanced | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Paloma Premier | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Paloma Private Client | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## ACH release figures

| Level | ACH-funded principal released before the debit settles, per rolling 30 days (USD) | Settlement wait for ACH-funded principal above that allowance (Paloma business days) |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 0.00 | 4 |
| Paloma Verified | 500.00 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 1500.00 | 3 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 3000.00 | 2 |
| Paloma Premier | 7500.00 | 2 |
| Paloma Private Client | 15000.00 | 1 |

## Points of reading

- Debit card and ACH bank debit are open at every level; credit card and instant pay-by-bank open at Paloma Verified; inbound domestic wire opens at Paloma Enhanced.
- An early-release allowance of 0.00 at Paloma Starter means no ACH-funded principal is released before the debit settles at that level.
- The settlement wait is counted in Paloma business days: Monday to Friday, excluding US Federal Reserve holidays.
